correctness.rationale: For all n>=4 finite simple trees, the Euclidean penultimate intrinsic-volume formula reduces by tree incidence Cauchy-Binet to 2 sum_e sqrt(s_e(n-s_e)). Every edge-cut term is at least sqrt(n-1), with global equality precisely for a star. For any nonpath, moving a smaller branch to a leaf in a second branch strictly raises every changed cut-product since n-2x-a>0; thus the path uniquely maximizes. Full tree incidence Gram determinant equals n, and the first intrinsic volume is (n-1)sqrt(2). The integral int_0^1 sqrt(x(1-x)) dx=pi/8 proves the ratio asymptotic. An independently implemented integer Bareiss checker verified every 18,247 labeled tree for n=3..7, but the infinite proof is analytical.

value.rationale: The natural n-vertex tree graphical zonotope family is simultaneously equicombinatorial (cubes), equi-volume (sqrt n), and equi-first-intrinsic-volume ((n-1)sqrt 2). Yet the surface-area spread is uniquely achieved by star and path and has unbounded ratio (pi/8)sqrt n. This is a complete, structurally motivated sharp geometric classification, not an arbitrary numerical case.
